LanguageData.SSC_Make_SuperDrug.label: Concentration of Purple Aphrodisiac Nanofluid
LanguageData.SSC_Make_SuperDrug.description: Evaporate excess liquid from 5 units of aphrodisiac nanofluid under reduced pressure to produce 1 unit of concentrate.
LanguageData.SSC_Make_SuperDrug_forth.label: Bulk Concentration of Purple Aphrodisiac Nanofluid
LanguageData.SSC_Make_SuperDrug_forth.description: Evaporate excess liquid from 20 units of aphrodisiac nanofluid under reduced pressure to produce 4 units of concentrate in one batch.
LanguageData.SSC_Make_SuperDrug_forth.jobString: Concentrating a batch of aphrodisiac nanofluid.
LanguageData.SSC_Make_SuperDrug_Rough.label: Rough Concentration of Purple Aphrodisiac Nanofluid
LanguageData.SSC_Make_SuperDrug_Rough.description: Heat aphrodisiac nanofluid directly to evaporate excess liquid. Heat and residue destroy or retain some active nanomachines, so 10 units of raw fluid are needed for 1 unit of concentrate. The product is identical to drug lab concentrate.
